{"subject":"Claim C019609 past payer filing limit, write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C019609 (patient PT0111, date of service 2026-10-04, service code S5125, 16 units, billed $86.40) was submitted 2026-12-13, which is 70 days after care. Summit Care Partners' filing limit is 60 days, so the claim is predicted to deny as D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this. I need a write-off decision on this claim from you. Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, ideally before any further processing, so the claim can be closed out correctly.

Thank you."}
